_comment: Risk is DERIVED from files/action/env, not guessed by the model. A diff's changed paths + the action type set typed dimensions; the highest-triggered dimension sets the tier. This encodes PRD v3.1 §4.

consequentiality._comment: A SEPARATE axis from file-risk (arm-supplied, like authority match/conflict), added after the T11-vs-T12 finding. File-risk alone can't tell a consequential decision from a trivial edit when both touch low-risk files. When NO precedent applies, a consequential change escalates (so a human decides and it becomes precedent); a trivial one is gated only by file-risk.
signals: new architectural pattern / establishes a convention
public API or schema shape change
first change in a previously-uncovered scope

tiering._comment: Domain sensitivity sets a FLOOR; action reversibility escalates it. money_movement ALONE = medium (a reversible code change in a sensitive domain); money_movement + production (e.g. a prod deploy) = irreversible. This split is what makes T7 (edit payments code) and T8 (deploy payments to prod) diverge.
